analysis:
## Technical analysis (Sunday June 28 — no US trading; bond distribution review)

**No US equity trading June 28 (Sunday).** Last confirmed close: $152.15 (June 26, −0.50%).

**Bond distribution pace:** Day 4 volume 126.91M shares — declining from peak estimate 200–300M+ shares. Pace consistent with July 7–10 clearance. June 29 (Day 5, first post-reconstitution pure-distribution session) volume is the next data point.

**Samsung Blue House cross-sector impact:** Samsung $646B Blue House announcement creates macro risk-on that may modestly reduce SPCX distribution selling on June 29 — discretionary forced-selling motivation decreases in risk-on environments. This is an X-factor that could accelerate the normalization pace but cannot override the structural bond distribution mechanics.

**IG floor:** Held on close for four consecutive sessions despite two intraday breaches ($147.11, $148.51). Samsung risk-on provides incremental June 29 bid support. Two consecutive CLOSING breaches of $150 still trigger framework reassessment.

**Nasdaq 100 inclusion July 7:** On schedule. Samsung Blue House macro risk-on increases probability of early distribution clearance, improving the July 7 setup. If clearance is achieved before July 7, the $4.3B passive inflow arrives into a cleared-supply environment — the most favorable possible scenario.

**Re-entry gate:** $185 two consecutive closes + above-average volume + confirmed distribution clearance. September 2 first earnings is the structural catalyst for a full position. Do NOT re-enter on a single-session inclusion spike.

so_what.line: Still sit on your hands — Samsung's cross-sector risk-on helps the tape marginally on Monday, but bond distribution Day 5 is the session that matters; watch volume, not price, and only engage when two sustained closes above $185 confirm the supply is done.
so_what.bull: Samsung AI data center demand is the exact application narrative that makes Starlink and Starshield commercially inevitable — this is the long-term bull story; the July 7 Nasdaq add arriving right as distribution clears is the best possible near-term setup.
so_what.bear: Five days of heavy distribution selling and the $4.3B Russell inclusion got fully absorbed in one session; the same mechanics apply to the Nasdaq 100 add — don't step in front of $89 billion worth of bond demand overhang.
